statement: The closest existing work is TempRALM (arxiv:2401.13222): the idea's core mechanism - a retrieval-agnostic, training-free addition of an elapsed-time temporal term to a retriever's semantic score, without re-indexing - is already published. The residual difference for the proposed idea is the application domain (amended statutes instead of web/Wikipedia versions) and the benchmark, which is a domain-transfer rather than a new mechanism.

evidence.quote: we define an auxiliary retrieval scoring function𝑇𝑒𝑚𝑝𝑅𝑒𝑡 𝑡 , which is the sum of the semantic score 𝑠(𝑞,𝑑) and the temporal score𝜏(𝑞𝑡,𝑑𝑡)
our approach could be used to extend any retriever that ranks documents using a numerical similarity score between a query and a document corpus
